mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month but 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM but 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, signaling a tightening monetary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% but 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase as described but 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 but 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a period of GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) declining by more than 0.5% month-over-month, supply-side constraints are likely, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM but 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
